headline: Uzbekistan Prioritizes Households and Hospitals for Winter Gas Allocation
summary: An Uzbek government resolution prioritizes natural gas supplies for households, schools, and hospitals through March. Temporary gas supply restrictions may be applied to industrial users during cold weather spikes.
why: Uzbekistan is a key Central Asian natural gas producer coping with rising domestic demand and seasonal supply shortages.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Restricting industrial gas consumption during peak winter months protects essential social infrastructure.
